reason: Read with the printed texts at hand, several words the image-only reading had misread became clear (Quos ... visitavit, imperito, ut purgatiore, quid ergo potissimum, invicti).

text:
F-1vo0 (Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 210). Source-assisted reading, 31 October 2026, made with PLS 2, PL 57 and PL 76 at hand. A research reader reread these lines on the native images: canvas 1 col. a and col. b in full; canvas 0 col. a lines 1-20 and col. b line-beginnings; canvas 2 col. a lines 15-27 and col. b lines 1-16; canvas 3 col. b last nine lines. All other lines rest on the image-only first reading.
Conventions: expansions in ( ), lost or supplied text in [ ], ? doubtful, / line break. Boxes are x,y,width,height in native pixels (4912 x 7360).
